name: Card
purpose: Groups related content in a visually distinct, flat surface — a dashboard widget, a settings group, a gallery tile.
neverUseFor: Dense lists or table rows — never Card-wrap individual list items, use Table or List/Item edge-to-edge instead
Modal or dialog surfaces — use Dialog, which needs its own focus-trap/portal behavior
Page-level layout structure — use AppShell for the page shell; Card is a content container, not a layout primitive
rationale: Card is a flat content container: per ADR-005 it never uses shadow, because a shadow reads as 'this floats' and Card sits inline in the page. Its width is decided by the consumer's layout, and it groups content without implying a landmark, so it composes into dashboards and settings without competing with Modal or AppShell.

mayExtendLocally: Compose any Helix content in the header and body slots
Lay Cards out in product-defined grids or flex rows
mustEscalateToDS: Adding box-shadow or elevation to Card or anything composed from it
New padding/radius variants or overriding the border tokens
Using Card as a dialog surface or page shell

anatomy.description: Root flat container — fill, border, radius. No shadow — see ADR-005; Helix is a flat design, shadow is reserved for overlay surfaces (Dialog, Tooltip, Popover, Menu).
Optional header row for a title and trailing actions.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional header content (e.g. a title + action buttons), rendered above the body with 8px of space between them, no divider.

props.name: padding
props.description: 'none' removes the body's internal padding — use when the content (e.g. a Table) manages its own edge-to-edge spacing.

width.note: Card fills its container by default; width is decided by the consumer's layout (e.g. a flex/grid gap), matching Button.json's minWidth precedent — no system token for this.

a11y.role: group (implicit — no explicit role unless the card represents a distinct landmark region)

properties.name: padding
properties.description: none: the body goes edge to edge (root has no top padding; a header keeps its own 24px top).

properties.name: header
properties.description: Show/hide part (show-hide-parts.md): the title row. With padding=default the 24px top lives on the root, the header carries only its 8px bottom, so toggling it never moves the body.
